summary: Gildan Activewear Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 third-quarter shareholder report, comprising Management's Discussion and Analysis, unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 27, 2026, and CEO/CFO certifications, all approved by the Board on November 4, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; content is ordinary quarterly reporting under IFRS/IAS 34 for a Canadian foreign private issuer. No special-situation event is present; monitor only for routine operating trends, leverage and capital-return commentary in future filings.
